{{Top|leg}}
'''Vibro-mines''' were a type of [[Mine/Legends|mine]]. They could be home-made, and were triggered by the arrival of a vehicle. A [[Governor/Legends|governor]] driving an [[SCS-19 Sentinel/Legends|SCS-19 Sentinel]] avoided several vibro-mines on his way to the office.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
